title: Nigeria Colleges of Education
description: Independently compiled factual reference data for the current National Commission for Colleges of Education register of active colleges of education. Each record represents one college of education listing after excluding non-COE NCE-awarding institutions and the stale Cross River row that has a successor university in the current universities register.
methodology: Independently compiled and cross-verified factual reference data from the public NCCE Accredited Colleges register. The register was retrieved three times with consistent 245-row results on 2026-08-30 before excluding the stale Cross River State Coll. of Education, Akampa row, which current Cross River State Government publications describe as transformed into the University of Education and Entrepreneurship, Akamkpa, already represented in ng-universities. SoftData compiled the 245-college NCCE boundary, excluded 19 non-COE NCE-awarding institutions, removed the directory-only OPEN marker from public names, normalized defective state labels, corrected five ownership cells that displayed the literal value 1 using official institution or government evidence, retained source spellings where no stronger official correction was found for Al-Ibadan COE, St. Paul's College of Education NNewi and A.D. Rufa’i College of Education, Legal and General Studies, and recorded the Yusuf Maitama Sule correction to Yusuf Maitama Sule College of Education & Advanced Studies, Ghari using the official institution site. The legacy archive was treated as a candidate inventory only. SoftData's independent compilation, schema and metadata are CC BY 4.0; NCCE and other official publications retain their own rights.
